text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the salon for accommodating nervous dogs, large breeds, and cautious cats. Reviewers highlight how groomers talk gently to frightened animals, creating a calm environment during nail clippings and full bath treatments. Clients who previously experienced difficulties at other parlours report complete trust in the team's ability to soothe companion animals.

Reviewers frequently commend groomer Cesar and the salon staff for their warm reception, energetic attitude, and clear communication. Clients appreciate that staff members take time to introduce themselves to first-time puppy clients and discuss individual styling preferences before starting. Pet parents note leaving appointments feeling reassured that their companions are in considerate hands.

Customers report satisfaction with the grooming outcomes, noting neat haircuts, thorough wash packages, and safely executed claw trimmings. A cat owner particularly commended the groomer for safely trimming an overgrown, curled claw without undue stress. Reviewers also appreciate the prompt turnaround of grooming appointments and the availability of self-service washing stations.

q.en: Does the salon groom cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm that groomers safely handle feline claw trimming alongside comprehensive canine grooming services.

q.en: Are self-service dog washing tubs available?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the facility provides self-service dog wash stations with all necessary bathing equipment.

q.en: Can nervous or fearful pets be groomed safely?

a.en: Yes, pet parents report that staff use calm reassurance and gentle techniques to keep anxious animals comfortable.

q.en: What are the parking arrangements near the salon?

a.en: Reviewers mention that on-street parking on Ray Street is limited, so pet owners often use brief drop-off stops.
